thread:
maya: Quick sync — token-cost attribution rollout status? I'm tracking schema PR, consumer work, and infra deps. Any blockers for canary this week?

alex: PR #421 merged into `schema/token-attrib` (not prod). Added fields: `token_count`, `model_variant`, `cost_cents`, `billing_tier`. Also added `prefix_cached` boolean for KV cache hints.

alex: Sample event we added (will send in PR comments too):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01F...",
  "user_id": "u_123",
  "model": "redwood-v1",
  "model_variant": "v1-q4_kg",
  "token_count": 84,
  "cost_cents": 12,
  "latency_ms": 210,
  "prefix_cached": true,
  "ts": 1700000000
}
```

alex: Main note — this is a schema-only change. We need consumers to start ingesting `cost_cents` + `model_variant` ASAP or the attribution will be partial.

maya: Who's owning the downstream join & reporting? analytics or eng-platform?

jordan: Analytics (me + tj) will own the join/aggregation for billing dashboards and the token-cost per-route metrics. We need an ETA on when events will be emitted for all routes.

tj: Confirming. Analytics will also own the rollup that backs /billing/usage and the model-variant heatmaps. Blocker: kinesis forwarder currently drops unknown keys — infra change required to forward new fields.

helen: Infra will enable schema-forwarding flag by EOD tomorrow if no regressions. We need a quick compatibility test matrix:
- ingest-only (no downstream change) -> safe
- full join (analytics consuming cost fields) -> staging only until canary

helen: I'll put a canary window on Thursday 10–14 PST for the forwarder toggle and monitor.

maya: OK milestone draft:
- Thu: infra forwarder toggle in staging (canary)
- Fri: analytics run validation job against canary data, check attribution completeness >99%
- Next Tue: small prod canary (10% traffic)
- Next Wed: full rollout if no regressions

alex: Also FYI: SDKs (js/python) will include typed event helpers. PRs for sdk-js #98 and sdk-py #34 targeted for Fri. Need eng-platform review on the helpers to ensure field names match.

maya: Who will review SDK PRs?

alex: tagging @maya and @helen for platform review, @jordan for analytics sanity check.

jordan: I'll do a quick pass on Friday afternoon. If anything off, we'll fallback to emitting legacy fields until fixed.

tj: Dependency checklist for analytics:
- forwarder flag enabled (infra) ✅ (helen will toggle)
- schema PR merged (alex) ✅
- sdk helpers released or temp mapper in ETL ✅ (we'll fallback to mapper)
- validation job ready (analytics) in staging by Fri ✅

maya: Risks?

alex: Risk: model_variant cardinality — we could blow up cardinality in metrics. Suggested mitigation: canonicalize variants to short tags (v1, v1-quant, v2) before storing. SDK helpers include a normalizer option.

jordan: We'll run cardinality checks during validation job, stop if >500 unique variants per day for a given customer.

helen: Ops note: forwarder toggle logs will hit S3; retention 7d for canary. I'll set alert for >5% schema errors.

infra-bot: build infra-forwarder@toggle flagged: staging toggle enabled by helen at 1752005400. CI: OK.

deploy-bot: schema PR #421 CI passed (unit + lint + integration).

maya: Action items:
- helen: enable staging forwarder toggle Thu 10am (done by 1752005400)
- alex: open SDK PRs + add normalizer notes (target Fri)
- jordan/tj: staging validation job + cardinality checks (Fri)
- maya: coordinate canary windows and monitor runbook

alex: pinging @data-eng for ETL mapper review — can someone from that team volunteer to review/merge mapper? :eyes:

jordan: @data-eng? any volunteers to own the small mapper change for initial rollout?

maya: If no volunteer by EOD tomorrow, analytics will ship a mapper in ETL to avoid blocking.

tj: Sounds good. I'll put the validation job dashboard link in this thread when ready.

maya: Thanks all — will post a short postmortem-style note after prod rollout. :thumbsup:

helen: noted. I'll watch the canary and post logs into #incidents if anything pops.

infra-bot: alert: staging schema errors at 1752006100 -> 0.4% (below threshold)

alex: Thanks — leaving final comments on PR.

maya: End of thread for status. Follow-ups in PRs & #eng-platform as needed.
